caption: The strategy step: a $100 daily budget was filled in by default, with an estimate of 23K to 47K impressions and 1.56K to 3.11K households a week across 569 streaming apps and channels.
Generate a creative built a 24 second slideshow from screenshots of pages on our own site, with a banner, QR code, music and voice over track, without any input from us.
The voice over script was written from our site text. The end card still read [phone number here] until you edit it.
A Traffic campaign needs a Vibe Page View event on the advertiser's website first; we switched to an Awareness campaign, which does not.
The summary step asked for a card before Publish Campaign, which allows Vibe to charge it for future payments. We stopped here and did not publish.
Pricing on 22 Nov 2026: CPM from $15 to $40 depending on channel and time, and a minimum spend of $50 a day.
